subject: Data Engineering
title: Building Your Own Stack
description: A 60-second lesson on Building Your Own Stack.

hook.text: There's no single 'right' data stack. The best stack is the one your team can actually operate.

buildup.text: Start with your biggest pain point. Is it ingestion, transformation, quality, or visibility?

discovery.text: Add one tool at a time. Validate it works before adding the next. Avoid buying the entire stack at once.

twist.text: The fanciest stack means nothing if the team doesn't have time to learn and maintain it.

climax.text: A simple stack you understand beats a complex stack you don't. Grow it as your needs and skills grow.

punchline.text: Start simple. Grow intentionally. Match the stack to the team.

quiz.question: What is the best approach to building a data stack?
options: Start with the biggest pain point and add one tool at a time
Buy every tool in the modern data stack immediately
